name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input OTP (input-otp). The slots are joined 44px cells in one 2px ink frame (shared lines collapse to one 2px rule), each character large in the lettering face. Hover thickens the frame; the active slot gets a 3px line inside (never over its neighbours) and a 2px ink caret blinking in steps; focus adds ink / paper / ink around the group. The separator is a short 2px dash. aria-invalid (on InputOTP or on a slot) turns the lines to the accent and adds a "!" mark beside the group; disabled is dashed with a tone frame in each cell, characters kept on paper. Six slots and a separator fit a 360px screen.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/input-otp". It wraps your own components/ui/input-otp, which is the same file in Radix and Base UI projects. The caret blinks with the stock caret-blink keyframes (tw-animate-css) in steps and stops with reduced motion.

meta.tagline: Code boxes joined in one ink frame, with a stepped caret.
meta.usage:
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSeparator, InputOTPSlot } from "@/components/ui/manga/input-otp"

<InputOTP maxLength={6}>
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
</InputOTP>

props.name: pattern
props.description: Allowed characters, e.g. REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS from input-otp.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: On InputOTP (or a slot): accent lines and a "!" mark beside the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dashed lines and a tone frame in each cell.

props.name: InputOTPSeparator
props.description: A short 2px ink dash between groups.
